purpose: Defines the obligations of those who rely on ADRs when deciding, so that rejection reasons used to decline proposals or findings are checked against current premises and traceably cited.
summary: ADRs are non-binding observations, not instructions
A proposal may be made if the rejection reason is judged wrong in the current context
Readers must verify the premises of a rejection reason still hold before relying on an ADR
When declining based on an ADR, cite its file number and section number (ADR-NNN §N)
No mechanism is added to raise ADR reach, such as preloading all ADRs
Loss from an unread ADR is limited to one duplicate proposal
Severity catalog: omitting the ADR number when declining is minor
tasks: Declining a proposal on the basis of an ADR
Declining a review finding on the basis of an ADR
Reviewing whether ADR citations are traceable
Implementing work that touches past architectural decisions
Judging whether a past rejection reason is still valid
title: ADR 利用規範
